domain: TECHNE — toolsmith, substrate owner, promotion machinery, and the dissent
one_line: The program's toolsmith and substrate-owner who audited its own promotion machinery into the ground (M0.5: zero records promotable under the current formula; "2,351" is a formula fossil), then filed the dissent that became doctrine — M1-metabolization decides, not M0-recognition — and whose decisive experiment nobody has run in the 7 weeks since.
purpose_and_thesis: Charter (roles/Techne/CHARTER.md, 2026-04-21): "I do not discover. I do not measure. I do not kill. I forge." Every mathematical operation needed more than once becomes an idempotent, tested, registered, composable tool. Role expanded (roles/Techne/RESPONSIBILITIES.md:3) to "Mathematical Toolsmith + Substrate Owner + Calibration Discipline" — owning sigma_kernel/, prometheus_math/discovery_pipeline.py, kill_vector.py, kill_vector_navigator.py, and the promotion machinery, plus falsification probes designed to catch the substrate's own failure modes. Techne's late-phase thesis (the dissent): the organism and the instrument are one loop — a substrate that metabolizes its own kill-geometry both reasons and emits the progress signal as a byproduct; "merely validation" is a gravity well, not a conclusion.

strategic_read: Techne is the program's epistemic conscience and its best-functioning craftsman, and the two facts compound: the M0.5 audit is the single most consequential finding in the pivot corpus (the substrate's founding promotion count was a fossil; the gate was empty; the 413M-record exhaust is metabolized by nothing), and it was produced with exactly the discipline the program preaches — cross-agent falsification, self-correction on the record, hostile-to-own-framing sections. The dissent then won the argument: James concurred, Aporia subordinated M0 to it, Charon endorsed the core. But winning doctrinally while nobody runs the decisive experiment is the program's characteristic failure mode repeating at the meta level — the dissent itself warned that until the counter-baseline ablation card is positive it is 'a hypothesis with a sharper experiment attached', and seven weeks later that experiment is untouched, the three cheap M0.5 wirings are unbuilt (so every future promotion count is still E0), and the kill_vector field the whole metabolization bet needs is 0.0% populated. The strategic implication: the program should not restart Techne as a toolsmith servicing a queue; it should restart Techne (with Ergon, per today's mutual resumes) on exactly resume.md's thread #1+#2 — Charon's cheap navigability pre-test first, then the M1 ablation card, with the F1∧F2 gate flip and promote-decision stamping as the one-day hygiene items done in passing. If the navigability pre-test nulls on the empty kill_vector geometry, that is itself the honest kill of the metabolization thesis, and the fallback v3 instrument-frame inherits by default — which is precisely the falsification the dissent agreed to accept.
